text: I visited on May 12, 2025. The doctor wasn't there, but when I asked the staff why there wasn't any notification on Line or anywhere else, the staff replied, "The doctor also has errands to run," with an annoyed expression. I understand that people have different emergencies and errands, but don't act like other people's time is worthless. If the staff had said, "I'm sorry, customer, the doctor is busy," the demeanor of the conversation would have changed immediately. In customer service, communication and facial expressions are very important. I drove from my house, almost an hour round trip. When I asked if I would be able to get laser treatment on my next visit, the staff replied, "The doctor has to assess my skin first," with a sigh. I then said, "It's nothing, I just wanted to know if I would be able to get it done. If I'm not sure, I won't come." Please reprimand the staff, Doctor. P.S.
